sn38.5:1.2: kittāvatā nu kho avuso assāsapatto hotī ti || ||
sn38.5:1.3: Yato kho āvuso bhikkhu channam phassāyatanānam samudayañca atthagamañ ca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānāti || ettāvatā kho āvuso assāsapatto hotī ti || || 4
sn38.5:1.4: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn38.5:1.5: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 5
sn38.5:1.6: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || ||
sn38.5:1.7: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāya || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn38.5:1.9: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāyāti || || 6
sn38.5:1.10: Bhaddako āvuso maggo || bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa assāsassa sacchikiriyāya ||
